Day 2 takes you to the natural wonders of Matagorda Bay, starting with breakfast at Sugar and Crumbs Cafe, followed by exploration at Matagorda Bay Nature Park and Big Boggy National Wildlife Refuge—perfect for those seeking scenic walks and wildlife encounters. You'll cap the day with another sumptuous meal at Grotto Wood-Fired Grill and Wine Cave.
